messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT P1 - kv-cache cont-batch runaway detected for model=mistral-qa (us-west-2). High eviction rate + steady growth in pending continuous_batch queues. Paging on-call: @oncall-alex

oncall-alex: acknowledged. I’m grabbing build + logs. Can someone drop the top-line metric links?

sre-jordan: link: https://grafana/reports/kv/2339 — eviction_rate spiked from 2% -> 48% in 6m, cont_batch_pending doubled. p50 latency up 220ms -> 1.9s.

infra-lee: seeing large prefix-cardinality growth from prefetch workers hitting qwen/mistral mix. Node thermal throttling also shows 2 GPUs in repro-compute had elevated GPU mem pressure. Logs: ```evict_rate=0.48 prefix_cardinality=~1.2M prefetch_workers=86```

ml-amy: note: MQA traffic on mistral-qa path is unusually high due to a customer batch pattern; GQA unaffected so far. MQA uses heavy KV prefix reuse which explodes prefix cardinality if rate-limited incorrectly.

oncall-alex: plan: 1) throttle prefetch workers (infra) 2) reduce continuous_batch window to mitigate growth (ops) 3) route critical customers to fallback variant (ml) 4) notify support/PMs.

infra-lee: throttling prefetch pool via admin api now: ```POST /admin/pools/prefetch/scale {"max_workers":20}``` — applied.

eng-ops: applying cont-batch hotfix to model config: change continuous_batch.max_aggregate_tokens from 200000 -> 60000 and set continuous_batch.eviction_safety_margin=0.12. Pushing config with canary 5% now. Command: ```rb rollout apply --model mistral-qa --canary 0.05 --patch-file hotfix/2339001111-contbatch.json```

pm-rita: support: we have 2 customer tickets for timeouts (acct:acme, acct:paloma). Marking impact: intermittent latency + timeouts for requests > 4k tokens. Flagging for CS triage.

ml-amy: also enabling model-routing fallback to mistral-compact for non-low-latency tier to preserve availability: ```/routing/policy update --model mistral-qa --fallback mistral-compact --threshold 0.8```

eng-ops: canary shows improvement in 3/5 nodes: eviction down 60%, p95 latency down ~450ms. Increasing canary to 25%.

incident-bot: NOTE: automated mitigations triggered: route-fallback enabled for 15% traffic; autoscale-block set to prevent prefetch surge.

oncall-alex: good. infra, keep throttles in place until we confirm steady-state for 30m. Jordan/SRE, collect timeline + logs for postmortem. Amy, prepare explanation for customers.

sre-jordan: collecting logs + tailing leaders. Snapshotting KV indices at t=2339001200. Command used: ```curl -sX POST https://admin/kv/snapshot?model=mistral-qa -H 'Authorization: Bearer ***'```

infra-lee: thermal readouts normalized after reducing prefetch concurrency. GPU temps down ~8C on affected nodes. eviction_rate trending to 6-8%.

eng-ops: canary -> 100% rollout at 2339001350. Hotfix commit: 9b2f4c3 (contbatch: tightened windows + safety margin). Rolling config to remaining replicas.

pm-rita: customer update drafted: "We've applied a mitigation to reduce request timeouts and will follow up with a root cause and timeline." Sending to CS.

oncall-alex: handing to oncall-sam for next 2 hours (TL;DR: patch applied, throttles in place, monitoring). oncall-sam: you good to take over?

oncall-sam: taking over. I'll monitor alerts and follow-up on postmortem items.

ml-amy: root cause hypothesis: prefetch + MQA workload interaction created super-linear prefix cardinality growth; continuous batching window allowed excessive aggregation so KV cache couldn't evict fast enough -> eviction blowups. Qwen requests contributed because of different tokenization causing fragmented prefixes. Llama/other families not impacted in this incident.

sre-jordan: short-term RCA notes captured. Will schedule postmortem and link test-repro. Also adding synthetic load test for MQA patterns to CI.

eng-ops: follow-up actions (captured): [1] Add alert for prefix_cardinality > 800k per model, [2] Add automatic throttle for prefetch when eviction_rate>20%, [3] Integrate canary target for cont-batch config changes, [4] Add customer-impact label to incidents when latency > 1s and >= 3 customers affected.

oncall-sam: confirming stabilization. No new pages after 10m. p95 latency back within SLO. Closing page.

incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED at 2339001456 — severity downgraded to P2, follow-up meeting scheduled.

pm-rita: scheduling customer postmortem comms + internal blameless postmortem doc. Assigning owners: eng-ops (action items), ml (repro + eval), infra (throttles + monitoring).

eng-ops: quick note: added a short-term guard in runtime to cap continuous-batch aggregation when prefix_cardinality > 500k (hotfix flag enabled). Will bake into proper config in next sprint.

oncall-alex: thanks all — great cross-team work. :thumbsup:
